in_sanskrit.name: Kamruddin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the beautiful garden
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kamruddin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kamruddin is a compound name derived from the Arabic and Persian languages. 'Kamru' means 'beautiful garden', and 'din' means 'lord'. Thus, Kamruddin translates to 'Lord of the beautiful garden'. This name is often used for boys in Hindu communities, particularly in India.
